cards.example_en: Too much sun can burn your skin at the beach.
cards.example_zh: 在海滩上，阳光太强会晒伤你的皮肤。

cards.example_en: We missed the last bus and walked home.
cards.example_zh: 我们错过了末班公交车，只好走回家。

cards.example_en: My uncle runs a small business near the market.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔在市场附近做着小生意。

cards.example_en: The busy waiter forgot our soup during the lunch rush.
cards.example_zh: 忙碌的服务员在午饭高峰时忘了我们的汤。

cards.example_en: It is cold, but the sun is out.
cards.example_zh: 天气很冷，但太阳出来了。

cards.example_en: She spread butter on the warm bread.
cards.example_zh: 她在热面包上抹了黄油。

cards.example_en: A yellow butterfly landed on the flower.
cards.example_zh: 一只黄蝴蝶落在花上。

cards.example_en: Mum will buy fresh fruit at the market after work.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈下班后会去市场买新鲜水果。

cards.example_en: She goes to school by bus.
cards.example_zh: 她坐公交车上学。

cards.example_en: Mum added cabbage to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈往汤里加了卷心菜。

cards.example_en: We shared a chocolate cake at the birthday party.
cards.example_zh: 生日聚会上，我们分着吃了一个巧克力蛋糕。

cards.example_en: Circle the exam date on the calendar.
cards.example_zh: 在日历上圈出考试日期。

cards.example_en: I will call my grandma after I get home.
cards.example_zh: 我到家以后会给奶奶打电话。

cards.example_en: Stay calm and read the question again.
cards.example_zh: 保持冷静，把题目再读一遍。

cards.example_en: Dad brought his camera to the school sports day.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸带上相机来参加学校运动会。

cards.example_en: Our class stayed at a camp beside the lake.
cards.example_zh: 我们班住在湖边的营地里。

cards.example_en: Can you help me carry this bag?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮我拿一下这个包吗？

cards.example_en: We may cancel the picnic if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能取消野餐。

cards.example_en: Doctors are working hard to treat lung cancer.
cards.example_zh: 医生们正在努力治疗肺癌。

cards.example_en: We lit a candle when the lights went out.
cards.example_zh: 停电时我们点了一支蜡烛。

cards.example_en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
cards.example_zh: 糖吃多了对牙不好。

cards.example_en: He forgot his red cap on the playground.
cards.example_zh: 他把红帽子落在操场上了。

cards.example_en: Paris is the capital of France.
cards.example_zh: 巴黎是法国的首都。

cards.example_en: Father washed the car on a sunny Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在一个晴朗的星期天清洗了汽车。

cards.example_en: I wrote a thank-you card for my teacher.
cards.example_zh: 我给老师写了一张感谢卡。

cards.example_en: Her care for the sick dog moved the whole family.
cards.example_zh: 她对生病小狗的关心感动了全家人。

cards.example_en: Please be careful when you cross the road.
cards.example_zh: 过马路时请小心。

cards.example_en: A careless mistake changed his score.
cards.example_zh: 一个粗心的错误改动了他的分数。

cards.example_en: I chopped a carrot for the vegetable soup.
cards.example_zh: 我切了一根胡萝卜来做蔬菜汤。

cards.example_en: Two students carry the heavy box up to the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 两个学生把这个重箱子搬到教室去。

cards.example_en: My little brother watches cartoons every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我弟弟每天早上看卡通片。

cards.example_en: The case of the missing keys worried everyone.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙不见了，这个情形让大家都担心。

cards.example_en: I paid in cash because the card machine failed.
cards.example_zh: 刷卡机坏了，所以我付了现金。

cards.example_en: Our cat sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我们的猫每天下午都在沙发上睡觉。

cards.example_en: Try to catch the ball with both hands.
cards.example_zh: 试着用双手把球接住。

cards.example_en: Wet roads can cause accidents near our school.
cards.example_zh: 湿滑的路面可能在我们学校附近引发事故。

cards.example_en: We celebrate my sister's birthday with a big cake.
cards.example_zh: 我们用一个大蛋糕庆祝姐姐的生日。

cards.example_en: The old stamp costs one cent.
cards.example_zh: 这枚旧邮票值一分钱。

cards.example_en: Our flat is central, so the ride to school is short.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓在市中心，所以去学校的路程很短。

cards.example_en: The sports centre opens at eight on weekdays.
cards.example_zh: 体育中心在工作日八点开门。

cards.example_en: This temple was built in the sixteenth century.
cards.example_zh: 这座寺庙建于十六世纪。

cards.example_en: I am certain the keys are still in my coat pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我确定钥匙还在我的外套口袋里。

cards.example_en: The empty chair by the window is still warm.
cards.example_zh: 窗边那把空椅子还是暖的。

cards.example_en: The teacher wrote the word in chalk.
cards.example_zh: 老师用粉笔写下了这个词。

cards.example_en: Climbing the hill was a real challenge for us.
cards.example_zh: 爬上那座山对我们来说真是个挑战。

cards.example_en: She became the champion of the city chess match.
cards.example_zh: 她成了全市象棋比赛的冠军。

cards.example_en: This match is our chance to reach the final.
cards.example_zh: 这场比赛是我们进入决赛的机会。

cards.example_en: A sudden change in the weather cancelled the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 天气突然改变，野餐只好取消。

cards.example_en: His honest character won the trust of his friends.
cards.example_zh: 他诚实的性格赢得了朋友们的信任。

cards.example_en: Patience is a useful characteristic for a teacher.
cards.example_zh: 耐心是老师很有用的特质。

word.example_en: She comes to school by bus.
Dad is in Shenzhen on business.
Dad is busy with his work this week.
She can not only sing but also dance.
word.example_zh: 她不但会唱歌，而且会跳舞。

word.example_en: Call me up if the plan changes.
word.example_zh: 如果计划变了，就打电话给我。

word.example_en: I will call back after dinner.
I need to make a telephone call to the clinic.
word.example_zh: 我需要给诊所打个电话。

word.example_en: Who will care for the cat this weekend?
word.example_zh: 这个周末谁来照料这只猫？

word.example_en: Take care on the icy road.
I care about my little brother.
I take care of the class plants.
Be careful of the wet floor.
Be careful about the time, or we will be late.
word.example_zh: 留意时间，不然我们会迟到。

word.example_en: Let us carry on with the story.
The team will carry out the survey.
In case of fire, use the stairs.
In that case, we can meet tomorrow.
word.example_zh: 既然那样，我们可以明天见。

word.example_en: Wear a coat so you do not catch a cold.
Run, or you cannot catch up with them.
word.example_zh: 快跑，不然你赶不上他们。

word.example_en: By chance, the shop was still open.
You will have a chance to try again.
I may change my mind after lunch.
word.example_zh: 午饭后我可能改变主意。
